policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="pocModel" value="@{
            try { return (string)context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true)["model"] ?? ""; }
            catch { return ""; }
        }" />
        
            
                
                    
                    
                        application/json
                    
                    @{
                        var message = "model_not_allowed: this key's product does not include the model '" + (string)context.Variables["pocModel"] + "'.";
                        if (context.Api.Id == "poc-claude") {
                            return new JObject(
                                new JProperty("type", "error"),
                                new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                                    new JProperty("type", "permission_error"),
                                    new JProperty("message", message)))).ToString();
                        }
                        return new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                            new JProperty("code", "model_not_allowed"),
                            new JProperty("type", "invalid_request_error"),
                            new JProperty("message", message)))).ToString();
                    }
